`home-assistant-javascript-templates-8.1.0-beta.1-entity-ids.tgz` is elchininet/home-assistant-javascript-templates#209 (8.1.0-beta.1) with `home-assistant-javascript-templates-entity-ids.patch` applied: the entity subscription asks `subscribe_entities` only for the entities the templates track, instead of every entity. Rebuild with `pnpm build && pnpm pack` in the library after applying the patch.
